requirement: R13 inventory coverage, verified gate, host-endpoint correlation and uniform categories

coverage.mechanism: Recursive scan of role-model-router/apps/runtime-ui/app/**/*.tsx excluding *.test.tsx; no directory exclusions. The test also parses routes.ts and fails on a registered path absent from inventory routePaths, so a routes.ts-only addition is detected.

statusCorrections.rule: verified requires a named, existing test in the proof file; wired means a tested partial port; absent means the new client does not serve the legacy entry.
statusCorrections.appLayout: route:app-layout -> absent. The new client has no /app route; visiting /app yields NotFound. A shell layout exists but that is the app-shell component, not this route.

route:index.proofTestName: index is a real success landing with working onward navigation

route:not-found.proofTestName: not-found is a terminal error state with recovery navigation

component:app-shell.proofTestName: shell preserves theme, title, focus and scroll facts across navigation

new-only:diagnostics.proofTestName: renders the ok state with records and identity

verifiedGate: Drift test requires proofTestName, asserts the proof file exists, and asserts the file contains it("<name>"). Wrong/absent names fail before any row can claim verified; package.json cannot pass.

categories.rule: A modal overlay is modal (device-authorization-modal and llama-swap-setup-modal); the non-modal device-authorization-card is device-auth. Static navigation/fallback/layout is control; read requires an actual data read. route:not-found is control, not read.

hostCorrelation.mechanism: Each row declares hostEndpoints and requiresHostEndpoint. The test parses host route literals from runtime-host-bridge/src/index.ts plus local-diagnostics-read.ts, normalizes trailing slash/wildcard prefixes, and fails if a row with requiresHostEndpoint=false declares an endpoint absent from the host. A fake absent endpoint is a negative control.
hostCorrelation.result: All declared endpoints on non-required rows are present; no missing endpoint on requiresHostEndpoint=false.
hostCorrelation.realFinding: S26a's 'no legacy route needs a new host endpoint' was wrong. Four rows declare endpoints absent from the host and are marked requiresHostEndpoint=true:
hostCorrelation.waves: Wave 4 now explicitly lists the missing /v1 endpoints; waves 1-3/5 point at row hostEndpoints rather than restating a blanket claim.

waves.changedProse: Wave prose references hostEndpoints/requiresHostEndpoint and the wave-4 missing endpoint list instead of repeating counts/endpoint claims.

checks: recursive app/** coverage incl. root.tsx and lib/*.tsx
routes.ts registered path must exist in inventory routePaths
verified requires named existing test source
declared endpoint absent from host fails unless requiresHostEndpoint=true
wave ids unique and cover every row
unproven: Host correlation covers explicitly declared endpoint literals, not every internal runtime-api call a route may make; studio endpoint absence is reported, not fixed.
